args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local players=game.Players:GetPlayers() assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and #players==1,'requires one isolated Studio player')
local player=players[1] local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG')
local command=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation')
local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player,world,storage)
 assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','refusing Reset outside EphemeralStudio')
 assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'refusing live-data Studio fixture')
 assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids Reset')
 assert(player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'profile must be ready ephemeral and non-writable')
 return true
end
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function captureScene(root,at)
 local sample={at=at,counts={parts=0,sounds=0,loaded=0,particles=0,debris=#root['Depth Physics Debris']:GetChildren()},parts={}}
 for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
  if object:IsA('BasePart')then sample.counts.parts+=1 sample.parts[object]=true
  elseif object:IsA('Sound')then sample.counts.sounds+=1 if object.IsLoaded then sample.counts.loaded+=1 end
  elseif object:IsA('ParticleEmitter')then sample.counts.particles+=1 end
 end
 return sample
end
local function sceneDelta(before,after,allowed)
 local delta={added=0,missing=0,unexpected=0,allowedMissing=0,addedNames={},missingNames={}}
 for object in pairs(after.parts)do if not before.parts[object]then
  delta.added+=1 if not allowed[object]then delta.unexpected+=1 end
  if #delta.addedNames<12 then table.insert(delta.addedNames,object:GetFullName())end
 end end
 for object in pairs(before.parts)do if not after.parts[object]then delta.missing+=1 if #delta.missingNames<12 then table.insert(delta.missingNames,object.Name)end end end
 for object in pairs(allowed)do if not after.parts[object]then delta.allowedMissing+=1 end end
 table.sort(delta.addedNames)table.sort(delta.missingNames)
 return delta
end
local function verifyScene(before,after,expectedAdded,delta)
 local a,b=before.counts,after.counts
 assert(delta.missing==0 and delta.unexpected==0 and delta.allowedMissing==0 and delta.added==expectedAdded,'scene instance identity changed beyond the verified egg')
 assert(b.parts==a.parts+expectedAdded and b.sounds==a.sounds and b.particles==a.particles and b.debris==0,'scene composition did not return to expected counts')
 assert(a.sounds>0 and a.loaded==a.sounds and b.loaded==b.sounds,'scene audio is not fully loaded')
 return true
end
local function verifyEgg(model,folder,player,startedAt,finishedAt,config)
 assert(model and model:IsA('Model') and model.Parent==folder and #folder:GetChildren()==1,'requires exactly one real spawned egg')
 assert(model.Name=='Mystery Pet Egg '..player.UserId and model:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='PetDropEgg' and model:GetAttribute('ServerAuthoritative')==true,'wrong egg identity')
 local id=model:GetAttribute('DropId') local owner=model:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId')
 local spawnedAt=model:GetAttribute('SpawnedAt')local expiresAt=model:GetAttribute('ExpiresAt')
 assert(type(id)=='string' and #id>0 and owner==player.UserId and id==player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggDropId'),'egg ownership and active drop identity disagree')
 assert(finite(spawnedAt) and finite(expiresAt) and spawnedAt>=startedAt-.001 and spawnedAt<=finishedAt+.001,'egg did not originate in the observed destruction')
 assert(finite(config.LifetimeSeconds) and config.LifetimeSeconds==24 and config.LifetimeSeconds<=30 and config.MaxActivePerPlayer==1,'pet lifetime or owner cap contract changed')
 assert(math.abs(expiresAt-spawnedAt-config.LifetimeSeconds)<.001 and expiresAt==player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggExpiresAt'),'expiry disagrees with authoritative lifetime')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('Claimed')==false,'egg was already claimed')
 local parts={}local names={}local count=0
 for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA('BasePart')then
  assert(object.Parent==model and not names[object.Name],'egg parts must be unique direct children')
  names[object.Name]=object parts[object]=true count+=1
 end end
 assert(count==7,'actual egg must have exactly seven parts')
 local function part(name,size,shape,query)
  local object=names[name]
  assert(object and object:IsA('Part') and object.Shape==shape and (object.Size-size).Magnitude<.00001,'actual egg shape or size does not match '..name)
  assert(object.Anchored and not object.CanCollide and not object.CanTouch and object.CanQuery==query,'egg collision flags do not match '..name)
  return object
 end
 part('Egg Ground Glow',Vector3.new(.12,2.85,2.85),Enum.PartType.Cylinder,false)
 local body=part('Mystery Pet Egg',Vector3.new(2.05,2.8,2.05),Enum.PartType.Ball,true)
 for index=1,5 do part('Egg Spot '..index,Vector3.new(.46,.58,.18),Enum.PartType.Ball,false)end
 assert(model.PrimaryPart==body,'egg primary part is not its actual body')
 return {id=id,owner=owner,spawnedAt=spawnedAt,expiresAt=expiresAt,parts=parts,partCount=count,name=model.Name}
end
local function verifyExpiry(record,model,folder,player,at)
 assert(finite(at) and at>=record.expiresAt and at<=record.expiresAt+1.1,'expiry observation is early or exceeded its bound')
 assert(model.Parent==nil and model:GetAttribute('RemovalReason')=='expired','original egg did not expire naturally')
 assert(#folder:GetChildren()==0 and player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggDropId')==nil and player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggExpiresAt')==nil and player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggDepth')==nil,'expired drop retained scene or owner state')
 return true
end
local diagnostics={contract='NaturalPetEggExpiryV1'}
local ok,result=pcall(function()
 verifyEphemeralSeed(player,root,game.ServerStorage)
 assert(command:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'reset failed')
 local config=G.PetDrops
 assert(finite(config.PityBreaks) and config.PityBreaks>=1 and config.PityBreaks%1==0,'invalid pity configuration')
 assert(command:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=500,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,PetDropPity=config.PityBreaks-1}).ok==true,'seed failed')
 local folder=root:FindFirstChild('Pet Egg Drops',true)
 assert(folder and #folder:GetChildren()==0 and player:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggDropId')==nil,'baseline contains a prior egg')
 local before=captureScene(root,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())diagnostics.before=before.counts diagnostics.beforeAt=before.at
 assert(before.counts.debris==0,'baseline physics debris is not empty')
 local startedAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local cycles=command:Invoke('BreakWallCycles','Brick Wall',20)
 local finishedAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()diagnostics.breakStartedAt=startedAt diagnostics.breakFinishedAt=finishedAt diagnostics.completed=cycles.completed
 assert(cycles.ok==true and cycles.completed==20,'original twenty destruction cycles did not complete')
 local model=folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
 local record=verifyEgg(model,folder,player,startedAt,finishedAt,config)
 diagnostics.egg={id=record.id,owner=record.owner,name=record.name,spawnedAt=record.spawnedAt,expiresAt=record.expiresAt,partCount=record.partCount,lifetime=config.LifetimeSeconds}
 task.wait(5)
 local five=captureScene(root,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())diagnostics.fiveSeconds=five.counts diagnostics.fiveAt=five.at
 assert(five.at>=finishedAt+5-.01 and five.at<record.expiresAt,'five-second observation missed the active egg window')
 local current=verifyEgg(model,folder,player,startedAt,finishedAt,config)
 assert(current.id==record.id and current.expiresAt==record.expiresAt,'active egg identity changed')
 local fiveDelta=sceneDelta(before,five,record.parts)diagnostics.fiveDelta=fiveDelta
 verifyScene(before,five,7,fiveDelta)
 local deadline=record.expiresAt+1
 while model.Parent and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<deadline do task.wait(math.min(.1,math.max(.001,deadline-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())))end
 local final=captureScene(root,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())diagnostics.after=final.counts diagnostics.afterAt=final.at diagnostics.removalReason=model:GetAttribute('RemovalReason')
 verifyExpiry(record,model,folder,player,final.at)
 local finalDelta=sceneDelta(before,final,{})diagnostics.finalDelta=finalDelta
 verifyScene(before,final,0,finalDelta)
 diagnostics.stable=true diagnostics.loadedAll=true diagnostics.naturalExpiry=true diagnostics.originalCycles=20
 return diagnostics
end)
assert(ok,'reduced scene lifetime failed: '..tostring(result)..' '..H:JSONEncode(diagnostics))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
